levels.surface: حيدر بن محمد بن نعيم السمرقندي
أبي النضر محمد بن مسعود العياشي

notes: «قال ابن قولويه» is the compiler speaking and is not written; the chain starts at the one who added the report
«أبي عبد الله البرقي» is written as the text gives it (a kunya with a nisba, not identified by the reader)
the Imam «أبي عبد الله (ع)» comes after «عن» inside the chain, so he is a narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling)
